title: Quadratic Equations
summary: An equation of the form ax² + bx + c = 0, where a, b, c are real numbers and a ≠ 0, is a quadratic equation in standard form (degree 2). The values of x that satisfy it are its roots (solutions); they are the zeros of the polynomial ax² + bx + c. A quadratic equation has at most two roots. To check whether a number is a root, substitute it: x = ½ is a root of x² + kx − 5/4 = 0 when ¼ + k/2 − 5/4 = 0, i.e. k = 2.

Write the equation in standard form, factorize the left side into two linear factors (split the middle term: two numbers whose product is ac and sum is b), and set each factor equal to zero. Example: x² − 3x − 10 = 0 ⇒ (x − 5)(x + 2) = 0 ⇒ x = 5 or x = −2.
The roots of ax² + bx + c = 0 are x = [−b ± √(b² − 4ac)] / 2a. Example: 2x² + x − 6 = 0 has a = 2, b = 1, c = −6, b² − 4ac = 1 + 48 = 49, so x = (−1 ± 7)/4, i.e. x = 3/2 or x = −2.

D = b² − 4ac is the discriminant. (i) D > 0: two real and unequal (distinct) roots. (ii) D = 0: two real and equal roots, each −b/2a (then c = b²/4a). (iii) D < 0: no real roots. Example: kx² − 12x + 6 = 0 has equal roots when 144 − 24k = 0, i.e. k = 6; x² − 3x + 3 = 0 has D = 9 − 12 = −3 < 0, so no real roots.

Form a quadratic equation from the data, solve it, and reject roots that do not make sense (negative ages, lengths or speeds, non-natural numbers). Useful set-ups: consecutive odd numbers x and x + 2; a number and its reciprocal x and 1/x; a right triangle with sides x and x + 7 and hypotenuse 13 (Pythagoras: x² + (x + 7)² = 13²); a boat with still-water speed u and stream speed v goes u + v downstream and u − v upstream, time = distance ÷ speed; rectangle area = length × breadth.
mcq: If the roots of ax² + bx + c = 0 are equal, then c is —

mcq.work:
Equal roots ⇒ discriminant b² − 4ac = 0.
4ac = b² ⇒ c = b²/4a.

D < 0, so the roots are not real.

mcq: The quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0 (a ≠ 0) has no real roots if —

mcq.work:
The roots are [−b ± √(b² − 4ac)]/2a.
If b² − 4ac < 0, its square root is not a real number, so there are no real roots.

mcq: Which of the following is a quadratic equation?

mcq.work:
A quadratic equation can be written as ax² + bx + c = 0 with a ≠ 0.
x² − 5x + 2 = 0 has degree 2. x³ + x = 1 has degree 3, 2x + 3 = 0 degree 1, and x + 1/x is not a polynomial.

x² − 3x − 10 = (x − 5)(x + 2).
Zeros: x = 5 and x = −2. Of the options, −2.
Check: 4 + 6 − 10 = 0 ✓.

Two numbers with product 12 and sum −7: −3 and −4.
(x − 3)(x − 4) = 0 ⇒ x = 3 or 4.

objective: Match: (i) The roots of 2x² + x − 6 = 0 are ____ (ii) The roots of x² − 3x + 3 = 0 are ____ — (A) real and distinct (B) real and equal (C) not real
Match: (i) If (α − 3)x² + 4(α − 3)x + 4 = 0 has equal real roots, α = ____ (ii) If x = ½ is a root of x² + kx − 5/4 = 0, k = ____ — (A) 3 and 4 (B) 4 (C) 2 (D) 6

(i) D = 16(α − 3)² − 16(α − 3) = 16(α − 3)(α − 4) = 0 ⇒ α = 3 or 4. α = 3 makes the x² term vanish (not a quadratic), so α = 4 → (B); the paper's key offers (A) '3 and 4'.
(ii) ¼ + k/2 − 5/4 = 0 ⇒ k/2 = 1 ⇒ k = 2 → (C).
Write True or False: (i) Every quadratic equation has exactly one root. (ii) If the roots of ax² + bx + c = 0 are equal, then b² − 4ac = 0.

(i) False: a quadratic equation has at most two roots — it may have two, two equal, or none real.
(ii) True: equal roots happen exactly when the discriminant is zero.

case.passage: A motorboat whose speed in still water is 18 km/h takes 1 hour more to go 24 km upstream than to return downstream to the same spot. Let the speed of the stream be x km/h.
items: The speed of the boat upstream is —

items.work: Going against the stream, the stream slows the boat: 18 − x.

items: The equation that describes the situation is —
The speed of the stream is —

items.work:
x² + 48x − 324 = (x + 54)(x − 6) = 0 ⇒ x = 6 or −54.
Speed cannot be negative, so x = 6 km/h.

Downstream speed = 18 + 6 = 24 km/h; time = 24 ÷ 24 = 1 hour = 60 minutes.
(Upstream: 24 ÷ 12 = 2 hours, one hour more ✓.)

items: The relation used for time is —

items.work: Distance = speed × time, so time = distance ÷ speed.

vsa: Solve x² + 12x − 160 = 0 to find the natural number which, when increased by 12, equals 160 times its reciprocal.
For what value of k does kx² − 12x + 6 = 0 have equal roots? Find the roots.

Equal roots ⇒ (−12)² − 4 × k × 6 = 0 ⇒ 144 = 24k ⇒ k = 6.
The equation is 6x² − 12x + 6 = 0 ⇒ 6(x − 1)² = 0 ⇒ x = 1, 1.
Find the nature of the roots of 2x² + x − 6 = 0 and find them.
The sum of two natural numbers is 15 and the sum of their reciprocals is 3/10. Find the numbers.

Let the numbers be x and 15 − x.
1/x + 1/(15 − x) = 3/10 ⇒ 15/[x(15 − x)] = 3/10 ⇒ x(15 − x) = 50.
x² − 15x + 50 = 0 ⇒ (x − 5)(x − 10) = 0 ⇒ x = 5 or 10.
The numbers are 5 and 10.
Find a natural number whose square diminished by 84 equals three times 8 more than the number.
Solve by the quadratic formula: x² − 4x + 1 = 0.
sa: Divide 16 into two parts such that twice the square of the larger part exceeds the square of the smaller part by 164.

Let the larger part be x; the smaller is 16 − x.
2x² − (16 − x)² = 164 ⇒ 2x² − (256 − 32x + x²) = 164
⇒ x² + 32x − 420 = 0 ⇒ (x + 42)(x − 10) = 0 ⇒ x = 10.
The parts are 10 and 6. Check: 2 × 100 − 36 = 164 ✓.

or: Ramu's age two years ago multiplied by his age five years from now gives 120. Find his present age.

Let the present age be x.
(x − 2)(x + 5) = 120 ⇒ x² + 3x − 10 = 120 ⇒ x² + 3x − 130 = 0.
(x + 13)(x − 10) = 0 ⇒ x = 10 (age cannot be negative).
Ramu is 10 years old.

sa: The length of a rectangular garden is 7 m more than its breadth. Its area is 144 m². Find the length and breadth.

Let breadth = b; length = b + 7.
b(b + 7) = 144 ⇒ b² + 7b − 144 = 0 ⇒ (b + 16)(b − 9) = 0 ⇒ b = 9.
Breadth 9 m, length 16 m.

or: The altitude of a right triangle is 2 cm more than its base and the hypotenuse is 10 cm. Find the other two sides.

Let base = x; altitude = x + 2.
x² + (x + 2)² = 10² ⇒ 2x² + 4x − 96 = 0 ⇒ x² + 2x − 48 = 0.
(x + 8)(x − 6) = 0 ⇒ x = 6.
Base 6 cm, altitude 8 cm.

sa: The sum of the squares of two consecutive odd numbers is 130. Find the numbers.

Let the numbers be x and x + 2.
x² + (x + 2)² = 130 ⇒ 2x² + 4x − 126 = 0 ⇒ x² + 2x − 63 = 0.
(x + 9)(x − 7) = 0 ⇒ x = 7 or −9.
The numbers are 7 and 9 (or −9 and −7).
The hypotenuse of a right triangle is 13 cm and the other two sides differ by 7 cm. Find them.

Let the sides be x and x + 7.
x² + (x + 7)² = 169 ⇒ 2x² + 14x − 120 = 0 ⇒ x² + 7x − 60 = 0.
(x + 12)(x − 5) = 0 ⇒ x = 5.
The sides are 5 cm and 12 cm.
The sum of the digits of a two-digit number is 13 and the sum of their squares is 89. Find the number.

Let the digits be a and b: a + b = 13, a² + b² = 89.
(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab ⇒ 169 = 89 + 2ab ⇒ ab = 40.
b = 13 − a: a(13 − a) = 40 ⇒ a² − 13a + 40 = 0 ⇒ (a − 5)(a − 8) = 0.
The digits are 8 and 5; the number is 85 or 58.
la: The sum of the areas of two squares is 640 m² and the difference of their perimeters is 64 m. Find the sides of the squares.
A girl is twice as old as her sister. Four years hence the product of their ages will be 160. Find their present ages.

Let the sister be x; the girl is 2x.
(2x + 4)(x + 4) = 160 ⇒ 2x² + 12x + 16 = 160 ⇒ x² + 6x − 72 = 0.
(x + 12)(x − 6) = 0 ⇒ x = 6.
Sister 6 years, girl 12 years. Check: 16 × 10 = 160 ✓.
The product of the digits of a two-digit number is 24. When 18 is added to the number, the digits interchange. Find the number.

Let the tens digit be x and the units digit y: xy = 24.
10x + y + 18 = 10y + x ⇒ 9y − 9x = 18 ⇒ y = x + 2.
x(x + 2) = 24 ⇒ x² + 2x − 24 = 0 ⇒ (x + 6)(x − 4) = 0 ⇒ x = 4, y = 6.
The number is 46. Check: 46 + 18 = 64 ✓.
A motorboat whose speed in still water is 18 km/h takes 1 hour more to go 24 km upstream than to return downstream. Find the speed of the stream.

Let the stream's speed be x km/h. Upstream speed 18 − x, downstream 18 + x.
24/(18 − x) − 24/(18 + x) = 1
⇒ 24(18 + x) − 24(18 − x) = (18 − x)(18 + x) ⇒ 48x = 324 − x²
⇒ x² + 48x − 324 = 0 ⇒ (x + 54)(x − 6) = 0 ⇒ x = 6.
The stream flows at 6 km/h. Check: 24/12 − 24/24 = 2 − 1 = 1 hour ✓.
